about: Renew a company or government entity's ICP establishment card.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Any fines on the establishment paid
Open to government bodies, private companies and free zone companies
documents: Government: establishing decree, board resolution, request letter, signature authorisation
Companies: trade licence, signature authorisation, memorandum of association for partnerships
fees: Late renewal 100 AED per month after 30 days, up to 1,000 AED
channels: ICP Smart Services website (sign in with UAE PASS)
